_comment: The certified models: the ones authors run crayon with. Each is pinned to one backend (provider.order + allow_fallbacks:false) and to Zero Data Retention endpoints only (zdr:true), so a score belongs to one model on one backend; both pins were on OpenRouter's /api/v1/endpoints/zdr list on 2026-10-25. price_per_mtok is [input, output] USD per million tokens on that backend; it sizes each call's budget reservation and is the fallback when a response carries no usage.cost. Models run with their default sampling and reasoning, as authors run them. prompt_cache adds cache breakpoints on the system prompt and the last user message. The gate model runs on every skill change; it is the cheapest certified model.
